description: Push a skill's local run records (and, on first push, the skill file) to your receipt ledger, where each receipt gets a shareable permalink + verified-replay badge. Requires an apiKey — from `reelier login` (or REELIER_CLOUD_KEY in env) — reports skipped-no-key honestly when absent; the cloud URL always resolves on its own. USE WHEN: a run's receipt should be durable or shareable.

all.description: Ignore/reset the cursor — reconsider every record from the start.

cwd.description: Working directory to resolve .reelier/ state under (default: the serve --workspace root when one was given, else process cwd).

dryRun.description: Report what would push; make no network calls, touch no state.

skillPath.description: Path to a .skill.md file whose run records should be pushed.

withSkill.description: Upload the skill file even if it was already uploaded before.

name: reelier_push
